title: Versioning, deprecation & maintenance policy + v1.0 release
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Elyos never holds patient data. A SemVer-based versioning/deprecation/maintenance policy plus the v1.0 release tags the standard with a changelog and a re-validation commitment (depends on all M2-M5 artifacts). Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Define the versioning/deprecation/maintenance policy and cut the v1.0 release with a changelog.
acceptanceCriteria: SemVer policy + migration/deprecation notes + >=annual re-validation commitment
